messages:
tara: Hey team — PR ready but blocked on architecture eyes. PR: https://gh.company/repo/pull/9832 RFC: https://docs.company/rfcs/2026-routing-kv-cache-short. Quick context: change routes to prefer local KV cache and add a lightweight fallback to remote shard when cache miss rate > 2%. No data model changes. Looking for: (1) arch blessing for rollout plan, (2) reconfirm SLO delta, (3) permission to merge into staging and schedule a 1hr canary tomorrow morning.

matt: Can you call out what we expect the latency impact to be in p90/p99?

 tara: p90 ~ flat, p99 ~ +20-30ms in worst case under synthetic load (we're adding async remote fetch path). Been running perfbench in pr branch, attaching numbers in PR description.

 eva: Skimmed RFC link. Need a 3-line summary in the PR description (what it changes, rollback path, SLO delta) and a test plan for the fallback path. Also want the safety bullet: are we handling auth/failures the same?

 tara: will add now. Auth unchanged — fallback uses existing signed token flow; failures return 503 and trigger fallback circuit breaker. I'll add test steps.

 jon: Heads up — release window tomorrow 08:00–09:00 UTC has a free 1hr canary slot. We can put this there if arch gives quick ok. Merge will be gated until we have the PR updates and an arch ack.

 eva: Quick note after reading PR updates: OK to proceed with canary provided you add SLO delta numbers and the rollback runbook. One more ask — add the RFC anchor (section id) to the PR so reviewers can link exact section.

 tara: added SLO numbers, rollback steps, and RFC anchor (see PR). Scheduling for 08:00 UTC canary. Thanks! :thumbsup:

 deploy-bot: Canary scheduled: PR #9832 -> staging, start 2026-07-22T08:00:00Z, duration 1h. Triggers: health-checks, p99 latency alert, error-rate > 0.5%

 jon: I'll watch the rollout and ping if we need to abort. Tara, mark me if you want the manual rollback button held.

 tara: will do — thanks all.
